name: forge
description: Operate the Symphony Forge harness: start tasks, save approved plans, record decisions, assumptions, and client sign-off, harvest the docs/context inbox, check gate status, and review proposed skills. Invoke when the user says "start a task", "save this plan", "record a decision", "harvest context", "is this PR ready", "harness status", "what now", "show me progress", "show the board", "review the plan", "create a new app", "set up a new project", or "/forge".
author: knacklabs
